GENERAL SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.

6. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics 3.2 Current Electricity 3.3 Mains Electricity 3.4 Projectile Moti.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrostatics? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Electrostatics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrostatics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrostatics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrostatics.
